chain_topology_findings.finding: PHASE-DSC-174 through PHASE-DSC-179 form a sequential sub-chain that binds PHASE-DSC-161 (release-archive-package), NOT PHASE-DSC-173, at the code level (services/directSpatialConditioningVendorRuntimeProfileRuntimeReleaseArchiveCertificationPackageBuilder.ts imports directSpatialConditioningVendorRuntimeProfileRuntimeReleaseArchivePackageBuilder.js = PHASE-DSC-161). No label edit was required to reach PASS, so none was made (rebuild-only path was sufficient, per the 'prefer rebuild-only if verify already PASSes' guidance).

chain_topology_findings.finding: PHASE-DSC-168 through PHASE-DSC-173 (already remediated by DSC-190) import directSpatialConditioningVendorRuntimeProfileRuntimeReleaseFinalCertificationReportBuilder.js = PHASE-DSC-179 (the historical filename-collision binding documented in DSC-190). chain_topology_findings.finding: PRE-EXISTING, OUT-OF-SCOPE OBSERVATION: every verify:direct-spatial-conditioning-vendor-runtime-profile-runtime-* script unconditionally rewrites its export + validation report file on each invocation, and two consecutive invocations of the SAME script (no upstream change) produce byte-different JSON (confirmed for PHASE-DSC-143 and PHASE-DSC-161 by direct byte-diff across repeated runs). This is pre-existing behavior in the generated builder pipeline (affects phases below and including 161, which were last touched in DSC-190/earlier phases), not something introduced by this phase. It does not violate the phases' own self-consistency check (each script validates its freshly computed value against itself at write time), but it means the digest chain's 'determinism' guarantee is really 'internally self-consistent at a given point in time', not 'byte-identical across repeated rebuilds'. This was accounted for by performing exactly one topologically-ordered rebuild pass end-to-end and confirming a second full pass in the same order also reports zero failures (i.e. the topology, not the exact bytes, is what stays deterministic).
chain_topology_findings.action_taken: Documented only; no source/schema/registry change made, out of PHASE-DSC-191's mandate (174-188 + binding chain refresh).
